skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my photos into a slideshow video with music and transitions — and get...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Maker With Photos: automatically turns photo collections into shareable videos with music, transitions, and 1080p output.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC uploads up to 200MB; ideal for social media creators.
- Simple setup with instant anonymous authentication and 100 free credits (7-day expiry).
- Full cloud-based rendering pipeline; easily export to popular formats like MP4 in under a minute.
- Built-in workflows for slideshow creation, batch processing, and iterative editing—no editing software required.
